name: Farm Sanctuary Southern California
description: Farm Sanctuary's 39-acre Southern California shelter for rescued farm animals, about 45 minutes from Hollywood. One-hour guided tours run Friday through Sunday; group tours are by appointment. Check the site for the current tour schedule and volunteer days.

name: The Gentle Barn
description: Sanctuary for rescued cows, horses, pigs, goats, and chickens. Open to the public on Sundays; reservations are recommended. See the site for hours and private-visit options.

name: Kindred Spirits Care Farm
description: A care farm and animal sanctuary in the San Fernando Valley that pairs rescued animals with community and education programs. Ranch open hours and volunteer sign-ups are posted on the site.
